resources.string: The service is connected. You can now configure IMS.
Pairing service found. Keep the system pairing dialog open, pull down the notification shade, and enter the six-digit code in the TensorIMS notification.
Pairing completed in this session, but the connection did not finish. Try reconnecting first.
Connection incomplete. Check wireless debugging and try again.
Paired before? Connect the phone to Wi-Fi and enable wireless debugging in Developer options, then connect and start the service.

1. Tap below and allow notifications and local discovery when prompted.\n2. Open Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code.\n3. Keep the dialog open, pull down notifications, and enter the code in TensorIMS.
